blocks.text: Crystalline solids mein atoms aur molecules ek regular tarteeb mein hote hain. Har molecule ke parosi (neighbours) ek hi pattern mein lage hote hain, aur yeh pattern poore crystal mein ek jaisa rehta hai. Is liye crystalline solids ki structure ordered (tarteeb wali) hoti hai.

blocks.alt: Ek jaise gulabi oval (ande jaisa lamba gol) hisson ke do jaal (networks), chhote gol jor par mile hue. Oopar: hisse regular chhe-kone chhalle (hexagonal rings) banate hain jo poori tasveer mein qataron mein dohraye jate hain. Neeche: har hissa ab bhi parosiyon se jura hai, lekin chhallon ki shakal aur size alag alag hai aur koi pattern nahi dohrata.
blocks.caption: For Your Information (PDF page 94): Glassy aur crystalline solid, chhote aur lambe faasle ki tarteeb (kitab ke is box ki tasveer ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.text: Zyada tar solids, jaise metals aur ceramics, crystalline hote hain, yani un ke atoms, molecules ya ions ek regular pattern mein hote hain. Yeh tarteeb X-ray Diffraction (XRD) aur Transmission Electron Microscopy (TEM) jaisi techniques se dekhi ja sakti hai. Yaad rahe ke crystal ke atoms ruke hue (static) nahi hote: har atom ek fixed point ke gird vibrate karta (thartharata) hai, aur temperature barhne se is vibration ka amplitude (jhoolne ki had) barhta hai. Atoms ki average jagahein hi lambe faaslon tak bilkul tarteeb mein hoti hain.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Oopar wala jaal crystalline solid hai: har jagah wahi chhalla (ring) dohraya jata hai, yani tarteeb door door tak qaim hai (long-range order). Neeche wala glassy (amorphous) solid hai: har hissa apne qareebi parosiyon se usi tarah jura hai (short-range order), lekin thore faasle ke baad tarteeb toot jati hai.

Crystalline solids mein atoms, molecules ya ions ke beech cohesive forces (aapas mein jor kar rakhne wali forces) vibrations ke bawajood lambe faasle ki sakht tarteeb (long-range order) qaim rakhti hain. Lekin har crystal ke liye ek aisa temperature hota hai jahan vibrations itni barh jati hain ke structure achanak toot jati hai aur solid pighal (melt ho) jata hai. Is liye solid (tarteeb) se liquid (disorder) mein badalna achanak (abrupt) hota hai. Har crystalline solid ka ek definite melting point hota hai, maslan quartz, calcite, cheeni (sugar), mica aur heera (diamond).
